name: Range
description: Represents a contiguous area in a document. Each Range object is defined by a starting and ending character position.
remarks: Similar to the way bookmarks are used in a document, Range objects are used in Visual Basic procedures to identify specific portions of a document. However, unlike a bookmark, a Range object only exists while the procedure that defined it is running. Range objects are independent of the selection. That is, you can define and manipulate a range without changing the selection. You can also define multiple ranges in a document, while there can be only one selection per pane. Use the Range method to return a Range object defined by the given starting and ending character positions. The following example returns a Range object that refers to the first 10 characters in the active document. Use the Range property to return a Range object defined by the beginning and end of another object. The Range property applies to many objects (for example, Paragraph, Bookmark, and Cell). The following example returns a Range object that refers to the first paragraph in the active document. The following example returns a Range object that refers to the second through fourth paragraphs in the active document. For more information about working with Range objects, see Working with Range objects.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Selects the specified range.

methods.name: SetRange
methods.signature: SetRange(Start As Long, End As Long)
methods.description: Sets the starting and ending character positions for an existing range.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The starting character position of the range.

parameters.name: End
parameters.description: The ending character position of the range.

methods.name: Collapse
methods.description: Collapses a range or selection to the starting or ending position. After a range or selection is collapsed, the starting and ending points are equal.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The direction in which to collapse the range or selection. Can be either of the following WdCollapseDirection constants: wdCollapseEnd or wdCollapseStart. The default value is wdCollapseStart.

methods.name: InsertBefore
methods.description: Inserts the specified text before the specified range.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text to be inserted.

methods.name: InsertAfter
methods.description: Inserts the specified text at the end of a range.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text to be inserted.

methods.name: Next
methods.signature: Next([Unit As Variant], [Count As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents the specified unit relative to the specified range.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The type of units by which to count. Can be any WdUnits constant.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of units by which you want to move ahead. The default value is one.

methods.name: Previous
methods.signature: Previous([Unit As Variant], [Count As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns the previous range a relative to the specified range.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The type of units by which to count. Can be any WdUnits constant.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of units by which you want to move back. The default value is 1.

methods.name: StartOf
methods.signature: StartOf([Unit As Variant], [Extend As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves or extends the start position of the specified range or selection to the beginning of the nearest specified text unit. This method returns a Long that indicates the number of characters by which the range or selection was moved or extended. The method returns a negative number if the movement is backward through the document.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which the start position of the specified range or selection is to be moved. Can be any WdUnits constant except wdLine. The default value is wdWord.

parameters.name: Extend
parameters.description: Specifies whether to move or extend the start of the range. If you use wdMove, both ends of the range or selection are moved to the beginning of the specified unit. If you use wdExtend, the beginning of the range or selection is extended to the beginning of the specified unit. The default value is wdMove.

methods.name: EndOf
methods.signature: EndOf([Unit As Variant], [Extend As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves or extends the ending character position of a range to the end of the nearest specified text unit.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which to move the ending character position. Can be any WdUnits, except wdLine. The default value is wdWord.

parameters.name: Extend
parameters.description: Specifies whether to move or extend the end of the range. If the value is wdMove, both ends of the range or selection object are moved to the end of the specified unit. If wdExtend is used, the end of the range or selection is extended to the end of the specified unit. The default value is wdMove.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move([Unit As Variant], [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Collapses the specified range to its start or end position and then moves the collapsed object by the specified number of units.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which to move the range.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of units by which the specified range is to be moved. If Count is a positive number, the object is collapsed to its end position and moved backward in the document by the specified number of units. If Count is a negative number, the object is collapsed to its start position and moved forward by the specified number of units. The default value is 1. You can also control the collapse direction by using the Collapse method before using the Move method. If the range is in the middle of a unit or isn't collapsed, moving it to the beginning or end of the unit counts as moving it one full unit.

methods.name: MoveStart
methods.signature: MoveStart([Unit As Variant], [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the start position of the specified range.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which start position of the specified range is to be moved.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of units by which the specified range is to be moved. If Count is a positive number, the start position of the range is moved forward in the document. If it is a negative number, the start position is moved backward. If the start position is moved forward to a position beyond the end position, the range is collapsed and both the start and end positions are moved together. The default value is 1.

methods.name: MoveEnd
methods.signature: MoveEnd([Unit As Variant], [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the ending character position of a range. .

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which to move the ending character position.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of units to move. If this number is positive, the ending character position is moved forward in the document. If this number is negative, the end is moved backward. If the ending position overtakes the starting position, the range collapses and both character positions move together. The default value is 1.

methods.name: MoveWhile
methods.signature: MoveWhile(Cset As Variant, [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the specified range while any of the specified characters are found in the document.

parameters.name: Cset
parameters.description: One or more characters. This argument is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters by which the specified range is to be moved. Can be a number or either the wdForward or wdBackward constant. If Count is a positive number, the specified range is moved forward in the document, beginning at the end position. If it is a negative number, the range is moved backward, beginning at the start position. The default value is wdForward.

methods.name: MoveStartWhile
methods.signature: MoveStartWhile(Cset As Variant, [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the start position of the specified range while any of the specified characters are found in the document.

parameters.name: Cset
parameters.description: One or more characters. This argument is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters by which the specified range is to be moved. Can be a number or either the wdForward or wdBackward constant. If Count is a positive number, the range is moved forward in the document. If it is a negative number, the range is moved backward. The default value is wdForward.

methods.name: MoveEndWhile
methods.signature: MoveEndWhile(Cset As Variant, [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the ending character position of a range while any of the specified characters are found in the document.

parameters.name: Cset
parameters.description: One or more characters. This argument is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters by which the range is to be moved. Can be a number or either the wdForward or wdBackward constant. If Count is a positive number, the range is moved forward in the document. If it is a negative number, the range is moved backward. The default value is wdForward.

methods.name: MoveUntil
methods.signature: MoveUntil(Cset As Variant, [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the specified range until one of the specified characters is found in the document.

parameters.name: Cset
parameters.description: One or more characters. If any character in Cset is found before the Count value expires, the specified range is positioned as an insertion point immediately before that character. This argument is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters by which the specified range is to be moved. Can be a number or either the wdForward or wdBackward constant. If Count is a positive number, the range is moved forward in the document, beginning at the end position. If it is a negative number, the range is moved backward, beginning at the start position. The default value is wdForward.

methods.name: MoveStartUntil
methods.signature: MoveStartUntil(Cset As Variant, [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the start position of the specified range until one of the specified characters is found in the document.

parameters.name: Cset
parameters.description: One or more characters. This argument is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters by which the specified range is to be moved. Can be a number or either the wdForward or wdBackward constant. If Count is a positive number, the range is moved forward in the document. If it is a negative number, the range is moved backward. The default value is wdForward.

methods.name: MoveEndUntil
methods.signature: MoveEndUntil(Cset As Variant, [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Moves the end position of the specified range until any of the specified characters are found in the document. If the movement is forward in the document, the range is expanded.

parameters.name: Cset
parameters.description: One or more characters. This argument is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The maximum number of characters by which the specified range is to be moved. Can be a number or either the wdForward or wdBackward constant. If Count is a positive number, the range is moved forward in the document. If it is a negative number, the range is moved backward. The default value is wdForward.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Removes the specified object from the document and places it on the Clipboard.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified range to the Clipboard.

methods.name: Paste
methods.description: Inserts the contents of the Clipboard at the specified range.

methods.name: InsertBreak
methods.description: Inserts a page, column, or section break.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of break to be inserted.Can be one of the WdBreakType constants. If omitted, the default value is wdPageBreak.

methods.name: InsertFile
methods.signature: InsertFile(FileName As String, [Range As Variant], [ConfirmConversions As Variant], [Link As Variant], [Attachment As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts all or part of the specified file.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the file to be inserted. If you don't specify a path, Word assumes the file is in the current folder.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: If the specified file is a Word document, this parameter refers to a bookmark. If the file is another type (for example, a Microsoft Excel worksheet), this parameter refers to a named range or a cell range (for example, R1C1:R3C4).

parameters.name: ConfirmConversions
parameters.description: True to have Word prompt you to confirm conversion when inserting files in formats other than the Word Document format.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: True to insert the file by using an INCLUDETEXT field.

parameters.name: Attachment
parameters.description: True to insert the file as an attachment to an email message.

methods.name: InStory
methods.description: True if the range to which this method is applied is in the same story as the range specified by the Range argument.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies the range that this method uses to determine if it is contained within the specified Range object.

methods.name: InRange
methods.description: Returns True if the range to which the method is applied is contained in the range specified by the Range argument.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies the range that this method uses to determine if it is contained within the specified Range object.

methods.name: Delete
methods.signature: Delete([Unit As Variant], [Count As Variant]) As Long
methods.description: Deletes the specified number of characters or words.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which the collapsed range is to be deleted. Can be one of the WdUnits constants.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of units to be deleted. To delete units after the range, collapse the range and use a positive number. To delete units before the range, collapse the range and use a negative number.

methods.name: WholeStory
methods.description: Expands a range to include the entire story.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Expands the specified range or selection. Returns the number of characters added to the range or selection. Long.

parameters.name: Unit
parameters.description: The unit by which to expand the range. Can be one of the following WdUnits constants: wdCharacter, wdWord, wdSentence, wdParagraph, wdSection, wdStory, wdCell wdColumn, wdRow, or wdTable.

methods.name: InsertParagraph
methods.description: Replaces the specified range with a new paragraph.

methods.name: InsertParagraphAfter
methods.description: Inserts a paragraph mark after a range.

methods.name: InsertSymbol
methods.signature: InsertSymbol(CharacterNumber As Long, [Font As Variant], [Unicode As Variant], [Bias As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts a symbol in place of the specified range.

parameters.name: CharacterNumber
parameters.description: The character number for the specified symbol. This value will always be the sum of 31 and the number that corresponds to the position of the symbol in the table of symbols (counting from left to right). For example, to specify a delta character at position 37 in the table of symbols in the Symbol font, set CharacterNumber to 68.

parameters.name: Font
parameters.description: The name of the font that contains the symbol.

parameters.name: Unicode
parameters.description: True to insert the unicode character specified by CharacterNumber; False to insert the ANSI character specified by CharacterNumber. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.description: Sets the font bias for symbols. This argument is useful for setting the correct font bias for East Asian characters. Can be one of the WdFontBias constants. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

methods.name: CopyAsPicture
methods.description: The CopyAsPicture method works the same way as the Copy method.

methods.name: SortAscending
methods.description: Sorts paragraphs or table rows in ascending alphanumeric order.

methods.name: SortDescending
methods.description: Sorts paragraphs in descending alphanumeric order.

methods.name: IsEqual
methods.description: True if the range to which this method is applied is equal to the range specified by the Range argument.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range to compare with the Range object defined by expression.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Calculates a mathematical expression within a range or selection. Returns the result as a Single.

methods.name: GoTo
methods.signature: GoTo([What As Variant], [Which As Variant], [Count As Variant], [Name As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents the start position of the specified item, such as a page, bookmark, or field.

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The kind of item to which the range is moved. Can be one of the wdGoToItem constants.

parameters.name: Which
parameters.description: The item to which the range is moved. Can be one of the wdGoToDirection constants.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of the item in the document. The default value is 1. Only positive values are valid. To specify an item that precedes the range, use wdGoToPrevious as the Which argument and specify a Count value.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: If the What argument is wdGoToBookmark, wdGoToComment, wdGoToField, or wdGoToObject, this argument specifies a name. Only positive values are valid. To specify an item that precedes the range, use wdGoToPrevious as the Which argument and specify a Count value.

methods.name: GoToNext
methods.description: Returns a Range object that refers to the start position of the next item or location specified by the What argument. .

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The item to where the specified range or selection is to be moved.

methods.name: GoToPrevious
methods.description: Returns a Range object that refers to the start position of the previous item or location specified by the What argument.

parameters.name: What
parameters.description: The item to where the specified range or selection is to be moved.

methods.name: PasteSpecial
methods.signature: PasteSpecial([IconIndex As Variant], [Link As Variant], [Placement As Variant], [DisplayAsIcon As Variant], [DataType As Variant], [IconFileName As Variant], [IconLabel As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts the contents of the Clipboard. .

parameters.name: IconIndex
parameters.description: If DisplayAsIcon is True, this argument is a number that corresponds to the icon you want to use in the program file specified by IconFilename. Icons appear in the Change Icon dialog box: 0 (zero) corresponds to the first icon, 1 corresponds to the second icon, and so on. If this argument is omitted, the first (default) icon is used.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: True to create a link to the source file of the Clipboard contents. The default value is False.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Can be either of the following WdOLEPlacement constants: wdFloatOverText or wdInLine. The default value is wdInLine.

parameters.name: DisplayAsIcon
parameters.description: True to display the link as an icon. The default value is False.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description: A format for the Clipboard contents when they're inserted into the document. Can be any WdPasteDataType constant.

parameters.name: IconFileName
parameters.description: If DisplayAsIcon is True, this argument is the path and file name for the file in which the icon to be displayed is stored.

parameters.name: IconLabel
parameters.description: If DisplayAsIcon is True, this argument is the text that appears below the icon.

methods.name: LookupNameProperties
methods.description: Looks up a name in the global address book list and displays the Properties dialog box, which includes information about the specified name.

methods.name: ComputeStatistics
methods.description: Returns a Long that represents a statistic based on the contents of the specified range.

parameters.name: Statistic
parameters.description: The type of statistic to compute.

methods.name: Relocate
methods.description: In outline view, moves the paragraphs within the specified range after the next visible paragraph or before the previous visible paragraph.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The direction of the move.

methods.name: CheckSynonyms
methods.description: Displays the Thesaurus dialog box, which lists alternative word choices, or synonyms, for the text in the specified range.

methods.name: InsertAutoText
methods.description: Attempts to match the text in the specified range or the text surrounding the range with an existing AutoText entry name.

methods.name: InsertDatabase
methods.signature: InsertDatabase([Format As Variant], [Style As Variant], [LinkToSource As Variant], [Connection As Variant], [SQLStatement As Variant], [SQLStatement1 As Variant], [PasswordDocument As Variant], [PasswordTemplate As Variant], [WritePasswordDocument As Variant], [WritePasswordTemplate As Variant], [DataSource As Variant], [From As Variant], [To As Variant], [IncludeFields As Variant])
methods.description: Retrieves data from a data source (for example, a separate Microsoft Word document, a Microsoft Excel worksheet, or a Microsoft Access database) and inserts the data as a table in place of the specified range.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: A format listed in the Formats box in the Table AutoFormat dialog box (Table menu). Can be any of the WdTableFormat constants. A border is applied to the cells in the table by default.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The attributes of the AutoFormat specified by Format that are applied to the table.

parameters.name: LinkToSource
parameters.description: True to establish a link between the new table and the data source.

parameters.name: Connection
parameters.description: A range within which to perform the query specified by _SQLStatement_.

parameters.name: SQLStatement
parameters.description: An optional query string that retrieves a subset of the data in a primary data source to be inserted into the document.

parameters.name: SQLStatement1
parameters.description: If the query string is longer than 255 characters, _SQLStatement_ denotes the first portion of the string and _SQLStatement1_ denotes the second portion.

parameters.name: PasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password (if any) required to open the data source. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: PasswordTemplate
parameters.description: If the data source is a Word document, this argument is the password (if any) required to open the attached template. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: WritePasswordDocument
parameters.description: The password required to save changes to the document. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: WritePasswordTemplate
parameters.description: The password required to save changes to the template. (See Remarks below.)

parameters.name: DataSource
parameters.description: The path and file name of the data source.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The number of the first record in the range of records to be inserted.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: The number of the last record in the range of records to be inserted.

parameters.name: IncludeFields
parameters.description: True to include field names from the data source in the first row of the new table.

methods.name: AutoFormat
methods.description: Automatically formats a document. Use the Kind property to specify a document type.

methods.name: CheckGrammar
methods.description: Begins a spelling and grammar check for the specified range.

methods.name: CheckSpelling
methods.signature: CheckSpelling([CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant], [AlwaysSuggest As Variant], [CustomDictionary2 As Variant], [CustomDictionary3 As Variant], [CustomDictionary4 As Variant], [CustomDictionary5 As Variant], [CustomDictionary6 As Variant], [CustomDictionary7 As Variant], [CustomDictionary8 As Variant], [CustomDictionary9 As Variant], [CustomDictionary10 As Variant])
methods.description: Begins a spelling check for the specified document or range.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True if capitalization is ignored. If this argument is omitted, the current value of the IgnoreUppercase property is used.

parameters.name: AlwaysSuggest
parameters.description: True for Microsoft Word to always suggest alternative spellings. If this argument is omitted, the current value of the SuggestSpellingCorrections property is used.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary2
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary3
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary4
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary5
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary6
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary7
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary8
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary9
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary10
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary. You can specify as many as nine additional dictionaries.

methods.name: GetSpellingSuggestions
methods.signature: GetSpellingSuggestions([CustomDictionary As Variant], [IgnoreUppercase As Variant], [MainDictionary As Variant], [SuggestionMode As Variant], [CustomDictionary2 As Variant], [CustomDictionary3 As Variant], [CustomDictionary4 As Variant], [CustomDictionary5 As Variant], [CustomDictionary6 As Variant], [CustomDictionary7 As Variant], [CustomDictionary8 As Variant], [CustomDictionary9 As Variant], [CustomDictionary10 As Variant]) As SpellingSuggestions
methods.description: Returns a SpellingSuggestions collection that represents the words suggested as spelling replacements for the first word in the specified range.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the custom dictionary.

parameters.name: IgnoreUppercase
parameters.description: True to ignore words in all uppercase letters. If this argument is omitted, the current value of the IgnoreUppercase property is used.

parameters.name: MainDictionary
parameters.description: Either an expression that returns a Dictionary object or the file name of the main dictionary. If you don't specify a main dictionary, Microsoft Word uses the main dictionary that corresponds to the language formatting of the first word in the range.

parameters.name: SuggestionMode
parameters.description: Specifies the way Word makes spelling suggestions. Can be one of the following WdSpellingWordType constants. The default value is wdSpellword.

methods.name: InsertParagraphBefore
methods.description: Inserts a new paragraph before the specified range.

methods.name: NextSubdocument
methods.description: Moves the range to the next subdocument.

methods.name: PreviousSubdocument
methods.description: Moves the range to the previous subdocument.

methods.name: ConvertHangulAndHanja
methods.signature: ConvertHangulAndHanja([ConversionsMode As Variant], [FastConversion As Variant], [CheckHangulEnding As Variant], [EnableRecentOrdering As Variant], [CustomDictionary As Variant])
methods.description: Converts the specified range from hangul to hanja or vice versa.

parameters.name: ConversionsMode
parameters.description: Sets the direction for the conversion between hangul and hanja. Can be either of the following WdMultipleWordConversionsMode constants: wdHangulToHanja or wdHanjaToHangul. The default value is the current value of the MultipleWordConversionsMode property.

parameters.name: FastConversion
parameters.description: True if Microsoft Word automatically converts a word with only one suggestion for conversion. The default value is the current value of the HangulHanjaFastConversion property.

parameters.name: CheckHangulEnding
parameters.description: True if Word automatically detects hangul endings and ignores them. The default value is the current value of the CheckHangulEndings property. This argument is ignored if the ConversionsMode argument is set to wdHanjaToHangul.

parameters.name: EnableRecentOrdering
parameters.description: True if Word displays the most recently used words at the top of the suggestions list. The default value is the current value of the EnableHangulHanjaRecentOrdering property.

parameters.name: CustomDictionary
parameters.description: The name of a custom hangul-hanja conversion dictionary. Use this argument to use a custom dictionary with hangul-hanja conversions not contained in the main dictionary.

methods.name: PasteAsNestedTable
methods.description: Pastes a cell or group of cells as a nested table into the selected range.

methods.name: ModifyEnclosure
methods.signature: ModifyEnclosure(Style As Variant, [Symbol As Variant], [EnclosedText As Variant])
methods.description: Adds, modifies, or removes an enclosure around the specified character or characters.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The style of the enclosure. Can be any WdEncloseStyle constant.

parameters.name: Symbol
parameters.description: The symbol in which to enclose the specified range. Can be any WdEnclosureType constant.

parameters.name: EnclosedText
parameters.description: The characters that you want to enclose. If you include this argument, Microsoft Word replaces the specified range with the enclosed characters. If you don't specify text to enclose, Microsoft Word encloses all text in the specified range.

methods.name: PhoneticGuide
methods.signature: PhoneticGuide(Text As String, [Alignment As WdPhoneticGuideAlignmentType], [Raise As Long], [FontSize As Long], [FontName As String])
methods.description: Adds phonetic guides to the specified range.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The phonetic text to add.

parameters.name: Alignment
parameters.description: The alignment of the added phonetic text.

parameters.name: Raise
parameters.description: The distance (in points) from the top of the text in the specified range to the top of the phonetic text. If no value is specified, Microsoft Word automatically sets the phonetic text at an optimum distance above the specified range.

parameters.name: FontSize
parameters.description: The font size to use for the phonetic text. If no value is specified, Word uses a font size 50 percent smaller than the text in the specified range.

parameters.name: FontName
parameters.description: The name of the font to use for the phonetic text. If no value is specified, Word uses the same font as the text in the specified range.

methods.name: InsertDateTime
methods.signature: InsertDateTime([DateTimeFormat As Variant], [InsertAsField As Variant], [InsertAsFullWidth As Variant], [DateLanguage As Variant], [CalendarType As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts the current date or time, or both, either as text or as a TIME field.

parameters.name: DateTimeFormat
parameters.description: The format to be used for displaying the date or time, or both. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Word uses the short-date style from the Windows Control Panel (Regional Settings icon).

parameters.name: InsertAsField
parameters.description: True to insert the specified information as a TIME field. The default value is True.

parameters.name: InsertAsFullWidth
parameters.description: True to insert the specified information as double-byte digits. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: DateLanguage
parameters.description: Sets the language in which to display the date or time. Can be either of the WdDateLanguage constants. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: CalendarType
parameters.description: Sets the calendar type to use when displaying the date or time. Can be either of the WdCalendarTypeBi constants. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

methods.name: Sort
methods.signature: Sort([ExcludeHeader As Variant], [FieldNumber As Variant], [SortFieldType As Variant], [SortOrder As Variant], [FieldNumber2 As Variant], [SortFieldType2 As Variant], [SortOrder2 As Variant], [FieldNumber3 As Variant], [SortFieldType3 As Variant], [SortOrder3 As Variant], [SortColumn As Variant], [Separator As Variant], [CaseSensitive As Variant], [BidiSort As Variant], [IgnoreThe As Variant], [IgnoreKashida As Variant], [IgnoreDiacritics As Variant], [IgnoreHe As Variant], [LanguageID As Variant])
methods.description: Sorts the paragraphs in the specified range.

parameters.name: ExcludeHeader
parameters.description: True to exclude the first row or paragraph header from the sort operation. The default value is False.

parameters.name: FieldNumber
parameters.description: The fields by which to sort. Microsoft Word sorts by FieldNumber, then by FieldNumber2, and then by FieldNumber3.

parameters.name: SortFieldType
parameters.description: The respective sort types for FieldNumber. Can be one of the WdSortFieldType constants. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sorting order to use when sorting FieldNumber. Can be any WdSortOrder constant.

parameters.name: FieldNumber2
parameters.description: The fields by which to sort.

parameters.name: SortFieldType2
parameters.description: The respective sort types for FieldNumber2. Can be one of the WdSortFieldType constants. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: SortOrder2
parameters.description: The sorting order to use when sorting FieldNumber2. Can be any WdSortOrder constant.

parameters.name: FieldNumber3
parameters.description: The fields by which to sort.

parameters.name: SortFieldType3
parameters.description: Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric.

parameters.name: SortOrder3
parameters.description: The sorting order to use when sorting FieldNumber3. Can be any WdSortOrder constant.

parameters.name: SortColumn
parameters.description: True to sort only the column specified by the Range object.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The type of field separator. Can be one of the WdSortSeparator constants.

parameters.name: CaseSensitive
parameters.description: True to sort with case sensitivity. The default value is False.

parameters.name: BidiSort
parameters.description: True to sort based on right-to-left language rules. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreThe
parameters.description: True to ignore the Arabic character alef lam when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreKashida
parameters.description: True to ignore kashidas when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreDiacritics
parameters.description: True to ignore bidirectional control characters when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreHe
parameters.description: True to ignore the Hebrew character he when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: LanguageID
parameters.description: Specifies the sorting language. Can be one of the WdLanguageID constants. Refer to the Object Browser for a list of the WdLanguageID constants.

methods.name: DetectLanguage
methods.description: Analyzes the specified text to determine the language that it is written in.

methods.name: ConvertToTable
methods.signature: ConvertToTable([Separator As Variant], [NumRows As Variant], [NumColumns As Variant], [InitialColumnWidth As Variant], [Format As Variant], [ApplyBorders As Variant], [ApplyShading As Variant], [ApplyFont As Variant], [ApplyColor As Variant], [ApplyHeadingRows As Variant], [ApplyLastRow As Variant], [ApplyFirstColumn As Variant], [ApplyLastColumn As Variant], [AutoFit As Variant], [AutoFitBehavior As Variant], [DefaultTableBehavior As Variant]) As Table
methods.description: Converts text within a range to a table. Returns the table as a Table object.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: Specifies the character used to separate text into cells. Can be a character or one of the following WdTableFieldSeparator constant. If this argument is omitted, the value of the DefaultTableSeparator property is used.

parameters.name: NumRows
parameters.description: The number of rows in the table. If this argument is omitted, Microsoft Word sets the number of rows, based on the contents of the range.

parameters.name: NumColumns
parameters.description: The number of columns in the table. If this argument is omitted, Word sets the number of columns, based on the contents of the range.

parameters.name: InitialColumnWidth
parameters.description: The initial width of each column, in points. If this argument is omitted, Word calculates and adjusts the column width so that the table stretches from margin to margin.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Specifies one of the predefined formats listed in the Table AutoFormat dialog box. Can be one of the WdTableFormat constants.

parameters.name: ApplyBorders
parameters.description: True to apply the border properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyShading
parameters.description: True to apply the shading properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyFont
parameters.description: True to apply the font properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyColor
parameters.description: True to apply the color properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyHeadingRows
parameters.description: True to apply the heading-row properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyLastRow
parameters.description: True to apply the last-row properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyFirstColumn
parameters.description: True to apply the first-column properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: ApplyLastColumn
parameters.description: True to apply the last-column properties of the specified format.

parameters.name: AutoFit
parameters.description: True to decrease the width of the table columns as much as possible without changing the way text wraps in the cells.

parameters.name: AutoFitBehavior
parameters.description: Sets the AutoFit rules for how Word sizes a table. Can be one of the following WdAutoFitBehavior constant. If DefaultTableBehavior is wdWord8TableBehavior, this argument is ignored.

parameters.name: DefaultTableBehavior
parameters.description: Sets a value that specifies whether Microsoft Word automatically resizes cells in a table to fit the contents (AutoFit). Can be one of the WdDefaultTableBehavior constant.

methods.name: TCSCConverter
methods.signature: TCSCConverter([WdTCSCConverterDirection As WdTCSCConverterDirection], [CommonTerms As Boolean], [UseVariants As Boolean])
methods.description: Converts the specified range from Traditional Chinese to Simplified Chinese or vice versa.

parameters.name: WdTCSCConverterDirection
parameters.description: Specifies the direction in which text is converted. If omitted, the default value is wdTCSCConverterDirectionAuto, which converts in the appropriate direction based on the detected language of the specified range.

parameters.name: UseVariants
parameters.description: True if Word uses Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR, and Macao SAR character variants. Can only be used if translating from Simplified Chinese to Traditional Chinese.

methods.name: PasteAndFormat
methods.description: Pastes the selected table cells and formats them as specified.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of formatting to use when pasting the selected table cells.

methods.name: PasteExcelTable
methods.signature: PasteExcelTable(LinkedToExcel As Boolean, WordFormatting As Boolean, RTF As Boolean)
methods.description: Pastes and formats a Microsoft Excel table.

parameters.name: LinkedToExcel
parameters.description: True links the pasted table to the original Excel file so that changes made to the Excel file are reflected in Microsoft Word.

parameters.name: WordFormatting
parameters.description: True formats the table using the formatting in the Word document. False formats the table according to the original Excel file.

parameters.name: RTF
parameters.description: True pastes the Excel table using Rich Text Format (RTF). False pastes the Excel table as HTML.

methods.name: PasteAppendTable
methods.description: Merges pasted cells into an existing table by inserting the pasted rows between the selected rows. No cells are overwritten.

methods.name: GoToEditableRange
methods.description: Returns a Range object that represents an area of a document that can be modified by the specified user or group of users.

methods.name: InsertXML
methods.description: Inserts the specified XML into the document at the specified range, replacing any text contained within the range.

parameters.name: XML
parameters.description: Specifies the XML to insert. This can be any valid custom XML.

parameters.name: Transform
parameters.description: Specifies the XML Transformation (XSLT) used to transform the XML. If omitted, the XML is inserted as custom XML without applying a transform.

methods.name: InsertCaption
methods.signature: InsertCaption(Label As Variant, [Title As Variant], [TitleAutoText As Variant], [Position As Variant], [ExcludeLabel As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts a caption immediately preceding or following the specified range.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: The caption label to be inserted. Can be a String or one of the WdCaptionLabelID constants. If the label has not yet been defined, an error occurs. Use the Add method with the CaptionLabels object to define new caption labels.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The string to be inserted immediately following the label in the caption (ignored if TitleAutoText is specified).

parameters.name: TitleAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry whose contents you want to insert immediately following the label in the caption (overrides any text specified by Title).

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Specifies whether the caption will be inserted above or below the range. Can be either one of the WdCaptionPosition constants.

parameters.name: ExcludeLabel
parameters.description: True does not include the text label, as defined in the Label parameter. False includes the specified label.

methods.name: InsertCrossReference
methods.signature: InsertCrossReference(ReferenceType As Variant, ReferenceKind As WdReferenceKind, ReferenceItem As Variant, [InsertAsHyperlink As Variant], [IncludePosition As Variant], [SeparateNumbers As Variant], [SeparatorString As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts a cross-reference to a heading, bookmark, footnote, or endnote, or to an item for which a caption label is defined (for example, an equation, figure, or table).

parameters.name: ReferenceType
parameters.description: The type of item for which a cross-reference is to be inserted. Can be any WdReferenceType or WdCaptionLabelID constant or a user defined caption label.

parameters.name: ReferenceKind
parameters.description: The information to be included in the cross-reference.

parameters.name: ReferenceItem
parameters.description: If ReferenceType is wdRefTypeBookmark, this argument specifies a bookmark name. For all other ReferenceType values, this argument specifies the item number or name in the Reference type option in the Cross-reference dialog box. Use the GetCrossReferenceItems method to return a list of item names that can be used with this argument.

parameters.name: InsertAsHyperlink
parameters.description: True to insert the cross-reference as a hyperlink to the referenced item.

parameters.name: IncludePosition
parameters.description: True to insert "above" or "below," depending on the location of the reference item in relation to the cross-reference.

parameters.name: SeparateNumbers
parameters.description: True to use a separator to separate the numbers from the associated text. (Use only if the ReferenceType parameter is set to wdRefTypeNumberedItem and the ReferenceKind parameter is set to wdNumberFullContext.)

parameters.name: SeparatorString
parameters.description: Specifies the string to use as a separator if the SeparateNumbers parameter is set to True.

methods.name: ExportFragment
methods.signature: ExportFragment(FileName As String, Format As WdSaveFormat)
methods.description: Exports the selected range into a document for use as a document fragment.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Specifies the path and file name of the file in which to save the document fragment.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Specifies the file format of the document fragment file.

methods.name: SetListLevel
methods.description: Sets the list level for one or more items in a numbered list.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: A number that indicates the new list level.

methods.name: InsertAlignmentTab
methods.description: Inserts an absolute tab that is always positioned in the same spot, relative to either the margins or indents.

parameters.name: Alignment
parameters.description: Indicates the type of alignment—left, center, or right—for the tab stop. Can be one of the WdAlignmentTabAlignment constants.

parameters.name: RelativeTo
parameters.description: Indicates whether the tab stop is relative to the margins or to the paragraph indents. Can be one of the WdAlignmentTabRelative constants.

methods.name: ImportFragment
methods.description: Imports a document fragment into the document at the specified range.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: Specifies the path and file name where the document fragment is stored.

parameters.name: MatchDestination
parameters.description: Specifies whether to match the destination formatting. If False, the imported document fragment retains the formatting in the original document. Default value is False.

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat(OutputFileName As String, ExportFormat As WdExportFormat, [OpenAfterExport As Boolean], [OptimizeFor As WdExportOptimizeFor], [ExportCurrentPage As Boolean], [Item As WdExportItem], [IncludeDocProps As Boolean], [KeepIRM As Boolean], [CreateBookmarks As WdExportCreateBookmarks], [DocStructureTags As Boolean], [BitmapMissingFonts As Boolean], [UseISO19005_1 As Boolean], [FixedFormatExtClassPtr As Variant])
methods.description: Saves a portion of a document as PDF or XPS format.

parameters.name: OutputFileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the new PDF or XPS file.

parameters.name: ExportFormat
parameters.description: Specifies either PDF or XPS format.

parameters.name: OpenAfterExport
parameters.description: Opens the new file after exporting the contents.

parameters.name: OptimizeFor
parameters.description: Specifies whether to optimize for screen or print.

parameters.name: ExportCurrentPage
parameters.description: Specifies whether to export the current page. True exports the entire page. False exports only the current selection.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: Specifies whether the export process includes text only or includes text with markup.

parameters.name: IncludeDocProps
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include document properties in the newly exported file.

parameters.name: KeepIRM
parameters.description: Specifies whether to copy IRM permissions to an XPS document if the source document has IRM protections. Default value is True.

parameters.name: CreateBookmarks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to export bookmarks and the type of bookmarks to export.

parameters.name: DocStructureTags
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include extra data to help screen readers, for example information about the flow and logical organization of the content. Default value is True.

parameters.name: BitmapMissingFonts
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include a bitmap of the text. Set this parameter to True when font licenses don't permit a font to be embedded in the PDF file. If False, the font is referenced, and the viewer's computer substitutes an appropriate font if the authored one is not available. Default value is True.

parameters.name: FixedFormatExtClassPtr
parameters.description: Specifies a pointer to an add-in that allows calls to an alternate implementation of code. The alternate implementation of code interprets the EMF and EMF+ page descriptions that are generated by the applications to make their own PDF or XPS. For more information, see Extend the fixed-format export feature in Word Automation Services.

methods.name: SortByHeadings
methods.signature: SortByHeadings([SortFieldType As Variant], [SortOrder As Variant], [CaseSensitive As Variant], [BidiSort As Variant], [IgnoreThe As Variant], [IgnoreKashida As Variant], [IgnoreDiacritics As Variant], [IgnoreHe As Variant], [LanguageID As Variant])
methods.description: Sorts the headings in the specified range.

parameters.name: SortFieldType
parameters.description: The sort field type to use. Can be one of the WdSortFieldType constants. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric. Depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed, some of these constants may not be available to you.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sorting order to use. Can be one of the WdSortOrder constants.

parameters.name: CaseSensitive
parameters.description: True to sort with case sensitivity. The default value is False.

parameters.name: BidiSort
parameters.description: True to sort based on right-to-left language rules. Depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed, this parameter may not be available to you.

parameters.name: IgnoreThe
parameters.description: True to ignore the Arabic character alef lam when sorting right-to-left language text. Depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed, this parameter may not be available to you.

parameters.name: IgnoreKashida
parameters.description: True to ignore kashidas when sorting right-to-left language text. Depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed, this parameter may not be available to you.

parameters.name: IgnoreDiacritics
parameters.description: True to ignore bidirectional control characters when sorting right-to-left language text. Depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed, this parameter may not be available to you.

parameters.name: IgnoreHe
parameters.description: True to ignore the Hebrew character he when sorting right-to-left language text. Depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed, this parameter may not be available to you.

parameters.name: LanguageID
parameters.description: Specifies the sorting language. Can be one of the WdLanguageID constants.

methods.name: ExportAsFixedFormat2
methods.signature: ExportAsFixedFormat2(OutputFileName As String, ExportFormat As WdExportFormat, [OpenAfterExport As Boolean], [OptimizeFor As WdExportOptimizeFor], [ExportCurrentPage As Boolean], [Item As WdExportItem], [IncludeDocProps As Boolean], [KeepIRM As Boolean], [CreateBookmarks As WdExportCreateBookmarks], [DocStructureTags As Boolean], [BitmapMissingFonts As Boolean], [UseISO19005_1 As Boolean], [OptimizeForImageQuality As Boolean], [FixedFormatExtClassPtr As Variant])
methods.description: Saves a portion of a document as PDF or XPS format.

parameters.name: OutputFileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the new PDF or XPS file.

parameters.name: ExportFormat
parameters.description: Specifies either PDF or XPS format.

parameters.name: OpenAfterExport
parameters.description: Opens the new file after exporting the contents.

parameters.name: OptimizeFor
parameters.description: Specifies whether to optimize for screen or print.

parameters.name: ExportCurrentPage
parameters.description: Specifies whether to export the current page. True exports the entire page. False exports only the current selection.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: Specifies whether the export process includes text only or includes text with markup.

parameters.name: IncludeDocProps
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include document properties in the newly exported file.

parameters.name: KeepIRM
parameters.description: Specifies whether to copy IRM permissions to an XPS document if the source document has IRM protections. Default value is True.

parameters.name: CreateBookmarks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to export bookmarks and the type of bookmarks to export.

parameters.name: DocStructureTags
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include extra data to help screen readers, for example information about the flow and logical organization of the content. Default value is True.

parameters.name: BitmapMissingFonts
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include a bitmap of the text. Set this parameter to True when font licenses don't permit a font to be embedded in the PDF file. If False, the font is referenced, and the viewer's computer substitutes an appropriate font if the authored one is not available. Default value is True.

parameters.name: UseISO19005_1
parameters.description: Specifies whether to limit PDF usage to the PDF subset standardized as ISO 19005-1. If True, the resulting files are more reliably self-contained but may be larger or show more visual artifacts due to the restrictions of the format. Default value is False.

parameters.name: OptimizeForImageQuality
parameters.description: Specifies whether to downsample images or keep their original quality. If True, the resulting files will have better image quality but may be larger. Default value is False.

parameters.name: FixedFormatExtClassPtr
parameters.description: Specifies a pointer to an add-in that allows calls to an alternate implementation of code. The alternate implementation of code interprets the EMF and EMF+ page descriptions that are generated by the applications to make their own PDF or XPS. For more information, see Extend the fixed-format export feature in Word Automation Services.
